g.text: Does reducing K preserve attainment per step and per second?
10 paired runs per method · n = 10 at each point · Fixed own targets
Top: exact nominal work checkpoints. Bottom: empirical distribution of batch-observed times.
Axes differ by case. Both methods finish at 10/10; subsecond differences require cautious interpretation.
